_doc: Vendor keys for the Gable Building Supply demo. The key is a stable short identifier the catalogue file uses to refer to the vendor; the loader resolves it to the vendor's name. All entries are invented.
_rules: All names, emails and phones are invented; no real company, brand or trademark.
A key is never changed or removed once the catalogue uses it.
Phones are on 250-555-01xx; emails are on the reserved .example domain or an invented one.
